The platform separates three planes. The data plane carries workload (workload inventory + HNDL exposure ranking, benchmarking put to work across solver families, industrialized winners with warm starts and SLAs); the control plane carries policy and orchestration (CBOM discovery through hybrid transition, scheduler/GPU/storage tuning and cloud burst); the evidence plane carries audit, replay and conformity documentation — the plane most vendors skip and every regulator asks about.
